v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Pilot-ready with supervision; first on-demand AWS smoke failed
v1.summary: Premium builder completion remains unproven; an initial AWS smoke run failed all three design specs before inference because of a Bedrock token-limit mismatch. A source fix merged but a successful repeated live run, independent premium judging, publishing and handoff remain unverified.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.summary: Owner-correction and store-support code expanded, but newly merged store features remain default-off and have no deployment or recurring live outcome proof. All five workers and integrations still need repeated provider-backed results.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.summary: AWS website smoke uncovered a new blocker despite a merged fix; merged store/support and release improvements remain incompletely live-verified. Supported complete SaaS and custom-agent deliveries, mature autonomy, and economics are still missing.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

dimensions.name: Business understanding & scope selection
dimensions.blocker: Real cross-industry scope accuracy and unsupported-scope refusal still lack a broad blind-tested customer sample.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Blind-test 20 varied businesses for accurate scope and refusals.

dimensions.name: Premium website delivery
dimensions.blocker: The first AWS on-demand smoke build failed all three design specs before inference on a Bedrock output-token ceiling; fix #329 merged, but successful rerun and 3 accepted production website handoffs remain unproven.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Retest AWS design-spec generation after #329, then prove 3 premium live deliveries with approval, revision, publication, export and unattended recovery.

dimensions.name: Complete SaaS & existing-app engineering
dimensions.blocker: No verified complete customer SaaS build and existing-app change workflow covering auth, backend, data, billing and deployment.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Deliver one bounded complete SaaS and one governed existing-app change end to end.

dimensions.name: Standard AI workforce capability
dimensions.blocker: Store support and order integrations merged but are behind default-off flags; no verified provider-backed useful outcomes for all 5 standard workers.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Record owner-approved live provider outcomes across all 5 workers.

dimensions.name: Automated custom-agent delivery
dimensions.blocker: Custom-agent assessment and sandbox groundwork are not a verified autonomous custom-agent build, test, activation and monitoring cycle.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove one supported custom agent from requirements through independent tests, activation and handoff.

dimensions.name: Autonomous coordination & recovery
dimensions.blocker: Builder stall/lock fixes merged, but actual unattended restart and spend-safe recovery of a parked website job remain unverified after release.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Recover real stopped/parked website work without manual rescue or duplicate spend.

dimensions.name: Reliability, security & ongoing maintenance
dimensions.blocker: Release speed/lock and test-harness fixes merged; on-demand AWS build fix has no confirmed successful end-to-end smoke or current production restore/soak receipt.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Prove safe release, timed restore and multi-copy failure soak on the deployed revision.

dimensions.name: Complete customer journey & ownership
dimensions.blocker: Owner source-corrections and logo export preservation merged; complete paid-like build, revision, live handoff and ownership export remain unrepeated on a single verified release.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Repeat full paid-like website journeys through revision, live handoff and ownership export.

dimensions.name: Commercial delivery & acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: Checkout and offers exist, but source-attributed real customer conversion and retention are not measured.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Verify real source-to-paid acquisition and ongoing customer delivery.

dimensions.name: Economic proof & low-founder-workload operation
dimensions.blocker: Paid delivery margins, failed-attempt costs, support burden and Darius hours are still not measured on a representative cohort.
dimensions.nextMilestone: Measure paid job margins and Darius intervention time on a representative cohort.

v1Remaining: Rerun the on-demand AWS builder after merged Bedrock output-ceiling correction; confirm design spec, full build and settled spend, with no manual repair.
Pass three consecutive founder-accepted premium website deliveries with independent motion/design review, revision, publication and ownership export.
Prove unattended recovery from a real job stall/restart, preserving progress, accounting and no duplicate spend.
Verify true owner status, safe rollback, support and production handoff on the same identified live release.
v2Remaining: Verify useful real-provider outcomes and approval controls for Maya, Jordan, Avery, Alex and Richard.
Activate and test the supported integration set across representative customers; flagged-off store features earn no live credit.
Prove recurring operation, incident recovery, ownership and maintenance with measured founder/operator involvement.
biggestChange: The first on-demand AWS website smoke build failed all three design specifications before inference; the Bedrock token-ceiling fix merged Oct 23, but no successful end-to-end rerun is verified.
improvements: Business Builder #673 merged on-demand AWS builder launching/runbook; dry-run reached running in ~45 seconds, not a full premium delivery.
Stromation #329 merged a bounded 16,384-token Bedrock design-spec ceiling fix with a regression test; no paid design-spec inference occurred in the failed smoke.
Business Builder #677/#678 merged release-cache and parallel validation work; #692/#698 merged owner correction/retained logo export fixes.
Business Builder #701 merged store support and Etsy/Shopify read-only integrations Oct 24, all behind flags default OFF.
regressions: First AWS smoke builder attempted all three design specs and hit an invalid Bedrock output ceiling before inference; successful post-fix rerun has not been established.
Actual previous builder stalls and job-lock failures have no confirmed repeatable unattended production recovery after merged fixes.
Premium judging previously accepted founder-rejected work; three consecutively accepted complete production deliveries are still absent.

merged: Stromation #329 merged Oct 23 cap to 16,384 output tokens for Bedrock; #327 remains open and earns no implementation credit.
Business Builder #673, #677/#678, #692, #698 and #701 merged; store support remains default-off.
Business Builder #702 remains open/draft and earns no implemented-capability credit.
deployed: PR #673 reports on-demand AWS infrastructure deployed with launch dry-run; app backend selector was unchanged, no live paid builder delivery established.
PR #702 cites previously healthy production release 7d794736, web :375 / worker :240; latest October 24 merges are not independently shown deployed.
verified: PR #329 reports a targeted source regression test and pre-inference failed AWS smoke; no post-fix complete smoke receipt verified.
PR #701 claims local 90+ store tests and large provider-stub cohorts, but flags OFF and no store customer proof.
PR #698 reproduces and fixes omitted historical logo originals in authenticated HTTP regression tests; live owner exports on latest release unverified.

promisesOverreach: Do not describe AWS builder as successfully running until a real post-fix on-demand design/build cycle completes.
Do not equate merged, flag-off store support with live integration or workforce value.
Do not present founder-rejected designs or failed first builder smoke as premium quality proof.
Do not claim complete SaaS/custom-agent delivery or measured 95–99% autonomy and 1–2 weekly Darius hours.
founderWorkloadTrend: Unknown: no consistent measured time series separates Darius intervention from customer approval, specialist review or operator effort.
nextActions: Verify post-#329 on-demand AWS builder completes real design generation, and independently judge the output against founder-approved/rejected examples.
Prove 3 premium end-to-end website deliveries on an identified released revision, with revision, published site, export and one controlled restart.
Record deployment SHA, recovery/spend receipts, independent acceptance and Darius/operator/customer-required minutes.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
businessOutlook.note: This is not a reliable demand forecast yet. One-time website/business build revenue is excluded from MRR.

costReporting.measuredSpend: No fresh complete delivery cost proof; #673 reports about $0.0017 start cost in a dry run, not an end-to-end build cost.
costReporting.reservedUnconfirmedSpend: No new independently verified cost receipts.
costReporting.note: Avoid presenting isolated dry-run spend as complete job costs.

method: 2026-10-24 independent rescore from latest canonical businessbuilder and integrated Stromation main commits, PR merge status, AWS launch/dry-run and first smoke failure, test reports and claimed limited live revisions. Open PR and default-off capabilities earn no implemented/live credit; merged fixes are not repeat production verification. No paid tests or deployments triggered.
